context: Hina and Sho excitedly plan to go to the pool.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、夏、プール、行きたい。
lines.en: Sho, can we go to the pool in summer?
lines.style: Bright, direct, the question landing with genuine eagerness. No hesitation—just sunny certainty that this is the best idea. Small voice but completely unguarded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも、行きたい！泳ぎたい。
lines.en: Me too! I want to swim!
lines.style: Quiet excitement, the words tumbling out in a small but genuine rush. No performance—just honest six-year-old delight at the idea.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Practical announcement wrapped in anticipation. Matter-of-fact but with a little sparkle underneath—she's already planning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful suggestion. The voice of someone who trusts the plan and knows exactly who to trust it with. Small but certain.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Swimming together is so much fun!
lines.style: Bright full-hearted declaration. Voice opens wide on the word 'fun'—the kind of pure joy that doesn't doubt itself. Closing warmth, no trailing-off.
